label: 014/L1 CONFIRMED as a process note: the live cron hop ran after the build, AC-001 is Met on the 2026-11-13 observation, and no operator failure or code change follows.

014/L2 CONFIRMED as intended: every deferred Stop re-enters the background-task branch, marks the record deferred and writes the systemMessage again. It fails only as transcript noise, and 039/001 adds the adjacent refusal of AskUserQuestion while the deferred record stays pending. Smallest change if wanted: print only when deferredAt was absent.

014/L3 CONFIRMED: session_crons entries carry id, schedule, recurring and prompt, but the adapter logs only sessionCrons.length, so a note without its Scheduled line leaves no recoverable list once the session ends. 039 did not close it. Smallest change: log each entry's schedule and prompt (or a redacted label) beside the count in the session-crons event, accepting prompt text in relaunch.log.

015/L1 CONFIRMED: only a live Pi --plan launch is recorded, not a Plan sender to Plan receiver hop. The adapter branch read, wrapper mode filter and launch flag are each tested, but the live integration is unproven and 039 ran no Pi hop. Smallest change: add --plan to the existing Pi live playbook hop and assert the receiver composer shows Plan, running in the primary checkout where the plan-build extension exists.

015/L2 CONFIRMED structurally: the wrapper drops every replayed --plan or --build when a Pi mode is carried, and replayed_extra_arguments mixes standalone flags with option values. No known Pi option takes a mode name as a value today, so the failure is latent: a future value would be removed and the option would consume the next token. Smallest change: keep value tokens distinguishable and filter only standalone flags.

015/L3 CONFIRMED and accepted: the declined descendant walk is the only change that would catch a shell below a non-shell child, and ADR-002 declines it because a reparented worker is out of reach. The note's Running workers line is the mitigation. No change by decision.

015/L4 CONFIRMED: when the Pi branch holds no plan-build entry or getBranch throws, liveSettings leaves mode unset and the wrapper replays the launch flags. A carried mode survives in the receiver launch line, so the gap bites only when the receiver switches mode after launch and its branch later becomes unreadable. Smallest change: export the carried mode and fall back to it when the branch is unreadable.

016/L1 CONFIRMED as an evidence limit, not a delivery gap: compact-pointer logs goal-start-claim and emits the claim as SessionStart context, and two adapter tests assert it. Ten runs bound model obedience, not the code path. 039 did not close it. Smallest change: a scripted larger live sample under the same open goal.

016/L2 CONFIRMED: run 1's sender created never-created-completion.flag and logged met=true before the hop, so only the other nine are clean evidence of a claim under an unmet goal. Smallest change: report 9 of 9 or add runs with the goal unmet; no code.

016/L3 CONFIRMED as recorded and CLOSED in code by 039/001 for Claude: the guard denies AskUserQuestion while the session's record is pending, so the four dialog-after-prepare runs can no longer park the hop. Residuals are 039/001's own: the saved runs had the harness run prepare, the guard is Claude-only, and other blocking dialogs are not matched. Smallest residual change: a live sender-run hop; add matchers only if Claude exposes another blocking tool.

016/L4 CONFIRMED and fixture-specific: the start-context lead already orders the claim before goal work, but a goal that says do nothing else suppressed the claim in three of five pong runs. The decision record accepts this because pong is a test fixture. 039 did not close it. No change for a real packet goal; change A from T010-T018 is the named fallback if a permissive-goal skip is seen.

017/L1 CONFIRMED as a live miss, with the negative control in the harness test: the old-script live look ended with No such file, while test-finish-run.sh recreates the folder two seconds in and fails against the old script. The risk is only a cause outside the observed shutdown window. 039 did not close it. No change.

017/L2 CONFIRMED: the settle loop removes each late write and prints the late-write line, but only the synthetic test has produced one; the live worker hop had no late write. The same rm -rf handles the first and later removals and a folder still present exits 1. No code change; FINISH_SETTLE_S is the override for a slow host.

017/L3 CONFIRMED: HS-8 links goal-records.cjs beside the patched script, while the proven live worker hop used a copied harness folder. A wrong link path would fail the sender before the hop. 039 did not close it. Smallest change: replace ln -s with cp on the HS-8 line, matching the proven run, or run HS-8 as written once.

017/L4 REFUTED as a coverage gap and CONFIRMED as a naming gap: the Pi adapter suite command runs the file holding the mode-carry cases, and the OpenCode adapter suite command runs the file holding the parent-idle-with-busy-child, deferred-arm and title cases. A regression fails the suite check, but the evidence lines do not name the cases. Smallest change: name the five cases in the two evidence lines; no test code.
